landing.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about veterinary practice management

faq.a: VetoCrm is veterinary practice management software (CRM / PIMS): clients, patients, appointments, consultations, vaccines, antiparasitics, inventory, and farms — a modern alternative to spreadsheets.

faq.q: Is VetoCrm a veterinary practice management system?
faq.a: Yes. VetoCrm covers scheduling, medical records, prescriptions, vaccine recalls, inventory and accounting — for solo practices and multi-vet clinics.

faq.q: Is VetoCrm suitable for a solo practice?
faq.a: Yes. A free starter plan lets you begin alone, then upgrade to multi-user plans as the team grows.
Yes. The multi-organization architecture isolates data per clinic, with admin and assistant roles.

faq.q: Can I manage vaccines and antiparasitics?
faq.a: Yes. Protocols, due dates, certificates, and history are built into the patient record.

faq.q: Can I try VetoCrm without signing up?
faq.a: Yes. The interactive clinic demo lets you explore the real app in read-only mode with realistic data, straight from the homepage.
